capability: Markdown rendering and sanitization (shared technical module)
description: Shared technical module, not a business domain. Renders Markdown to sanitized HTML with link and media handling for note nodes, text output previews, release notes, node help, node previews, and agent replies. The note-nodes and text-output-preview records explicitly leave shared Markdown rendering outside their capability; this record is that owner.

characterizationScenarios.name: Markdown renders to sanitized HTML with safe links and media

compatibilityPromises: Existing exports and behavior stay stable. All domains may import the listed public entry points subject to role rules; internal imports remain restricted.
